title: Billing Account Data
description: A schema representing billing and account information.

summaryAccountId.description: The unique identifier of the summary account.

summaryAccountNumber.description: The number or identifier assigned to the summary account by the provider.

normalizedSummaryAccountNumber.description: The normalized version of the Summary account number (removing things like hyphens, underscores, and leading zeros).

customerNumber.description: The bill contains a unique identifier for the customer associated with the account. This is not the account number.

invoiceNumber.description: The unique identifier or number assigned to a specific invoice.

isFinalBill.description: Indicates if this is the final bill for the account.

previousStatementDate.description: The date of the previous bill.

dueDate.description: The due date for payment associated with the account.

periodStartDate.description: The start date of the measuring period.

periodEndDate.description: The end date of the measuring period.

previousBalance.description: The balance carried forward from the previous billing period.

newCharges.description: Any new charges applied to the account since the last billing cycle or statement.

totalCharges.description: The total charges applied for a specific billing period.

amountDue.description: The monetary amount that is required to be paid.

amountDueBeforeDueDate.description: The total amount due for the account before the due date, excluding any late fees or penalties.

amountDueAfterDueDate.description: The total amount due for the account after the due date, excluding any late fees or penalties.

outstandingBalance.description: The remaining balance yet to be paid for the account.

discountBeforeDueDate.description: Any discounts applied to the account if the outstanding balance is paid before the due date.

charges.description: Details of charges applied, including amounts, currency, etc.

accountData.description: Data related to individual accounts, including billing information, usage history, etc.

cycleNumber.description: The code or ID for a meter reading schedule.

disconnectDate.description: The date on which the service for the account was disconnected.

sourceType.description: The data format of the data extraction source we used.

dataIngestionMethod.description: Indicates the method you used to send data to us.

credentialIds.description: A unique identifier for a credential.

createdAt.description: A timestamp indicating when the entity account was created.

discoveredAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the account data was discovered and added to the system.

lastModifiedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when this resource was last modified.
